shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,165p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && cat AGENTS.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -a && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Switch TextInput Select Modal Checkbox ThemeProvider Progress'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 26 -B 3 '"'^## Navigation|''^## Icons'"' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && sed -n '1,170p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@3 @gravity-ui/icons'
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Switch TextInput Select Modal Checkbox ThemeProvider Progress'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -L -s --max-time 25 https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/potok-icons.html && python - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/potok-icons.html').read()
for word in ['House','Layout','Folder','Gear','Sun','Moon','Bell','Arrow','Plus','CircleCheck','Magnifier','Ellipsis','Calendar','Person','Chart','Square','Chevrons','ArrowRight','Sliders','CircleQuestion','ArrowUpRight']:
 names=sorted(set(re.findall(r'\\b'+word+r'[A-Za-z0-9]*',s)))
 print(word, names[:20])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,re
s=urllib.request.urlopen('https://gravity-ui.com/icons',timeout=25).read().decode()
open('/tmp/potok-icons.html','w').write(s)
for word in ['House','Layout','Folder','Gear','Sun','Moon','Bell','Plus','CircleCheck','Magnifier','Ellipsis','Calendar','Person','Chart','Square','Chevrons','ArrowRight','Sliders','CircleQuestion','ArrowUpRight','ArrowDown','Clock','Check','Bars','Xmark']:
 print(word,sorted(set(re.findall(r'\\b'+word+r'[A-Za-z0-9]*',s)))[:16])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 14 'interface ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -135 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/ProgressWithValue.d.ts && rg -n -- '--g-color-base-(float|background|generic|positive|utility|info)|--g-border-radius|--g-spacing' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg 'README|styles|AsideHeader.css|Logo.*d.ts|FooterItem.*d.ts|Menu.*d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -240 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -180 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js | head -120 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Content/Content.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build | head -25 && rg -n -- '--gn-aside|--gn-composite|--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.css | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/Item/Item.d.ts | head -130 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/types.d.ts | head -130"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--gn-[a-zA-Z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.js | sort -u | head -80 && rg -n 'AsideHeader|aside-header|expandedSize|ASIDE_HEADER' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.js | head -25 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeaderContext.d.ts && npm ls @bem-react/classname @gravity-ui/icons @gravity-ui/uikit"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--gn-[a-zA-Z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-CVOBofNk.js | sort -u | head -100 && rg -n 'var ASIDE|ASIDE_HEADER|const AsideHeader|function AsideHeader|expandedSize|--gn-aside-header' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-CVOBofNk.js | head -35 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '120,152p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-CVOBofNk.js && sed -n '4620,4687p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-CVOBofNk.js && rg -n 'export.*Flex' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-button-[a-zA-Z0-9-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | sort -u && cat .gitignore && ls node_modules/.bin && cat vite.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check && git status --short'
